The word "hip" alone names a body part to train around, not damage or a question about a symptom. The system rules map it to a limitation, but the limitation vocabulary has no hip option. The closest movement-pattern limitations are knees, lower_back and no_jumping, and mapping a hip onto one of those would be a guess about their body. The athlete gave a body part with no detail, so I'll ask what movements to avoid, keeping it a training question.

Which movements bother it: squatting deep, lunging, running, or something else? Tell me what to keep out and I'll build around it.
